title: Add each element to its mirror
starter:
%x  = buffer 12 dtype=i32 slot=0
%o  = buffer 12 dtype=i32 slot=1

final contents of slot 1

hints: Copy the shape of device_same_as_loop: a device loop of 3, a global loop of 1, a local loop of 4. Device d owns elements 4d to 4d + 3, so the store offset is %i = 4d + 4b + t.
The mirror of element i is 11 - i: %r = sub 11 %i. Load %x at %i and at %r, then add the two.
After the store, close the loops from the inside out: %et = end %s %t, %eb = end %et %b, %ed = end %eb %d, then %o1 = after %o %ed.

answer.code:
%x  = buffer 12 dtype=i32 slot=0
%o  = buffer 12 dtype=i32 slot=1
%d  = range 3 axis=device
%b  = range 1 axis=global
%t  = range 4 axis=local
%ds = mul %d 4
%m  = mul %b 4
%e  = add %m %t
%i  = add %ds %e
%xv = shrink %x %i []
%xe = load %xv
%r  = sub 11 %i
%rv = shrink %x %r []
%re = load %rv
%y  = add %xe %re
%ov = shrink %o %i []
%s  = store %ov %y
%et = end %s %t
%eb = end %et %b
%ed = end %eb %d
%o1 = after %o %ed
answer.explain: Each device owns 4 elements of o and stores at 4d + 4b + t, so o is sharded with stride 4. The load of x[11 - i] reaches into another device's part, which is allowed because x is only read. Its reads don't all follow the slice rule, so x is replicated: every device gets all 12 elements.

require: give each device one block: range 1 axis=global
